replaces_unpublished_local_draft.reason: The local draft mixed valid Meta, Google and Performance Max leaf decisions with obsolete monthly/sent email-cost allocation and an unsupported Flow Variation hierarchy.
preserved_decisions_only: Google Ads standard leaf is Ad.
Google Performance Max leaf is Asset Group.
Klaviyo Audience is targeting metadata, not a performance leaf.

included: Klaviyo Campaign Variation GA activation gate
Delegation to the authoritative Klaviyo email cost allocation contract
excluded: modification of the Klaviyo email cost allocation formula

cost_contract_delegation.rule: This analytical-leaf contract consumes allocated_spend and may not restate, replace or override the authoritative cost formula.
cost_contract_delegation.campaign_variation_allocation: May begin only after the GA gate proves identity mapping and prevents Campaign Message and Campaign Variation double counting.

required_steps: Read the current official Klaviyo 2026-10-15 GA documentation.
Prove the identity mapping between Reporting API variation grouping and Campaign Variation API resource identity; labels and names are insufficient.
Version Dataset V2 entity keys, mapper, query and aggregation contracts.
Allocate Campaign Message email cost to real Campaign Variations without duplicating parent cost and preserve account-day totals.
Keep Flow at Flow Message unless current official evidence introduces a stable lower resource and identity mapping.
Run read-only preflight, repository tests and controlled non-empty live acceptance under separate approval gates.

invariants: Meta financial performance terminates at Ad.
Google Ads standard financial performance terminates at Ad.
Google Performance Max financial performance terminates at Asset Group; no fake Ad Group or Ad is created.
Klaviyo Campaign performance currently terminates at Campaign Message.
Klaviyo Flow performance terminates at Flow Message and no Flow Variation is inferred.
Klaviyo Audience remains targeting metadata and never owns performance or allocated spend.
The analytical-leaf contract cannot change the daily email cost or its current recipient-weighted allocation.
Campaign Variation activation cannot double count Campaign Message facts or allocated spend.
No schema write, runtime activation, provider mutation or backfill occurs in this contract-only package.

rollback.before_runtime_activation: Supersede this contract with a new versioned decision; do not delete historical evidence.
rollback.after_runtime_activation: Disable the versioned leaf feature flag, retain raw facts and allocated-spend auditability, and restore the last accepted hierarchy without deleting evidence.
